_about: Style-bible stream proposal for src/lib/theme.ts. Same keys as theme.ts plus additions. Each entry: value (proposed), was (current theme.ts), reason. All px are at 1080 px canvas width; card-local unless noted. Evidence and method: docs/style_bible.md (section numbers in reasons) and docs/style_evidence/.

bg.reason: Unchanged. Page bg measured exactly rgb(166,202,187) with 0 variance (flat).

card.reason: Unchanged. Card measured pure 255 white, no grain, no shadow (see Card notes below).

ink.reason: Median core colour of line and caption strokes across 4 scenes = rgb(43,27,10). Same ink for art and captions.

sun.reason: Unchanged. Measured rgb(236,107,46) in every scene.

highlight.reason: Unchanged. Caption box measured rgb(246,184,146) in 8 boxes.

peach.reason: #E4BC9E does not occur in the reference. The only peach is the highlight paint, reused for placards, screens, awnings, doors (k-means cluster #F6B791 = same paint).

salmon.reason: No second peach/salmon exists in the reference; alias to peach so existing uses stay on-palette. Prefer palette.peach in new code.

tan.reason: Measured dark-wall / shade-step cluster rgb(186,151,126) ('clay'). Most-used fill in the warm scenes (29-36% of panel).

brown.reason: The reference's brown is an ochre rgb(136,101,47): hair, jackets, tree trunks, sign posts. #836C54 is not in the reference.

teal.reason: Measured door / frame / coat teal rgb(84,121,119).

tealDark.reason: Measured rgb(62,96,95); 1-unit refinement. Darkest fill: shade step, door kick panels, ATM body, dusk sky.

sage.reason: Measured rgb(109,152,139): glass panes, tree crowns, coats, cladding.

mintPale.reason: Measured rgb(235,246,229): ground, glass, light facades.

olive.reason: No olive/khaki exists in the reference. Dark trousers/objects use tealDark or ink. Aliased to tealDark; avoid in new code.

grey.reason: No neutral grey exists in the reference (palette is all warm/teal). Paper dog-ears and soft shades use sand. Aliased to sand; avoid in new code.

sky.reason: NEW. Explicit name for the panel sky block (same paint as bg; measured rgb(166,201,186), 1 unit off = identical).

sand.reason: NEW. Missing role: mid walls, necks/skin, coats, light hair, paper dog-ears. 13% of the street scene, 28% of the dusk wall.

white.reason: NEW. Paper, signs, line-art (unfilled) people, glass glare. 6-14% of panel in several scenes.

card.reason: Unchanged. Width 960 equals the reference card width exactly, so every px number in the bible transfers 1:1 to card-local coords. Corners square (radius 0 measured). Bottom edge (canvas 1520) sits where platform UI starts.

panel.reason: Reference panel is inset exactly 96 px (= 0.10 x card width) on left, right and top and is 768 wide (0.80 x card width). Height 944 (vs 768 square in the 4:5 reference) uses the extra 9:16 height while keeping caption baselines inside the safe zone. Canvas: x 156-924, y 216-1160.

captionZone.reason: Max line width 780 keeps a centred line inside canvas x 150-930 (safe zone 90-930; centre stays on the card centre x=540). Zone spans line-1 cap top (1152) to line-2 descender (1330) +-16 px; canvas y 1256-1476 < 1480.

sun.reason: Radius measured 71-72 px in all 13 wide shots (0.075 x card width). Default centre = reference opening position: 36 px below the panel top so the disc crosses the panel edge (top of disc 36 px above panel). Across scenes the centre ranges cx 320-752, cy 115-155. Canvas top of disc = 180 (> safe 160).

ink.reason: Coverage width of default architectural lines at mid-length measured 3.3-3.7 px (ledges, kerbs, door frames).

inkThin.reason: Distant / detail lines: distance-transform median 2.0-2.5 px (far street, skyline windows, bikes).

inkBold.reason: Foreground figures, heavy ledges and kerbs measured 4.5-5.2 px.

inkHair.reason: NEW. Glass glints, paper text lines, crane cables, tapered line ends (1.5-1.8 px).

taperEnd.reason: NEW. Long lines (>150 px) thin to ~45% of their width over the last 8-10% of length at both ends (ledge line: 3.5 px mid, 1.5-2.3 px at the ends).

family.reason: Unchanged name. File public/fonts/CaptionHand.woff2 = Patrick Hand Regular 400 (OFL). Overlay vs reference: ink IoU 0.88 after Chromium render, widths within 0.1%, highlight boxes within 1 px. The reference IS Patrick Hand.

size.reason: Reference set at 82 px on a 960 px card (8.5% of card width): x-height 38, cap height 55, ascender 60, descender 26 px.

color.reason: Same ink as the art (keep referencing palette.ink).

weight.reason: NEW. Patrick Hand has one weight. Never fake-bold.

letterSpacing.reason: NEW. Width fit across 8 lines is best at 0 (sd 0.1%); any tracking breaks the match.

fontFeatures.value: kerning normal; ligatures on (font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures contextual)
fontFeatures.reason: NEW. The looped 'll' in all/million/normally is the font's ligature; it must stay on.

align.value: center on card x = 480 (canvas 540), by advance width
align.reason: NEW. Reference lines are centred on the card centre to within 1 px.

baselines.reason: NEW. Card-local. Reference: line 1 sits 175 px below the panel bottom, line 2 +96. A 1-line caption that will get a 2nd line sits on line 1. A one-line 'punch' caption is centred (reference baseline 1152 screen = midpoint + 4).

punchScale.reason: NEW. 'Half a million came.' is set at ~95 px (x1.16), alone and centred.

hookScale.reason: NEW. The opening/loop caption ('France expected / 200,000 marchers.') is ~87 px with 103 px line gap (x1.06).

maxLineWidth.reason: NEW. Safe-zone limit (see captionZone). ~27 characters per line at 82 px (avg advance 28 px/char).

clip.reason: NEW. Card-local caption viewport for the roll: lines enter from below the card bottom edge (clipped by it) and exit upward, clipped ~30 px under the panel bottom (reference: ~27 px).

highlight.reason: NEW. Fitted on 8 reference boxes: box = [word advance start - 0.02em, word advance end + 0.11em] x [baseline - 0.671em, baseline + 0.305em] (at 82 px: -1.6/+9 px, 55 px up, 25 px down, h 80, r 3). Multi-word phrases get one continuous box incl. spaces. Trailing . or , is NOT covered. Text stays ink.

misreg.reason: Measured fill-vs-ink offsets are 2-5 px but the direction varies per object (cat +x+y in 4 scenes, jacket +x 5-7 px, doorbell +x, sage coat -x, backpack -x-y, paper -x+y). A fixed up-left shift reads as a mechanical print error; a small +x+y bias with +-3 jitter reproduces the mix (x in [-1.5,4.5], y in [-2,4]).

highlightWipe.reason: Measured at 30 fps: 'same' box wipes L->R from 0 to 100% in 0.25 s with strong ease-out (87% width after 0.1 s), landing as line 2 settles.

captionLine.reason: Line 2 roll-in measured 11 frames (0.37 s) from +40 px below to its baseline, ease-out (cubic).

captionRoll.reason: Unchanged; measured: old block exits upward in ~0.07-0.1 s (45 px/frame), new line rises from +112 px to its baseline over ~0.4 s, ease-out.

cardSurface.reason: NEW / toolkit request. Reference card is flat 255 white (std 0.06) with a hard edge straight onto flat mint: no paper grain, no drop shadow. If kept for taste, grain opacity <= 0.15 and shadow <= 0.06 alpha.

overshoot.reason: NEW. Ink beyond the panel edge measured per scene: L 53-60, R 53-61, top 20-96 (crane/props), bottom 0-47 px. Corner overshoot: structural lines (ledges, kerbs, roof lines) 30-62 px past the panel; windows/doors/frames 6-15 px; small details 3-8 px.
